payload.answer:
Based on the retrieved procurement records for Solicitation **SOL-2026-CLOUD-01**, here is the calculation of the SLA service credits owed under Exhibit 05:

---

### 1. CLIN-0001-AA: Shared VPC & Landing Zone Core
* **Monthly Fee:** **$45,000.00/month** (*04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf*, p. 1; *05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf*, p. 1).
* **Monthly Availability:** **99.40%**.
* **SLA Classification & Credit Percentage:** 
  * Under Clause SLA-4.2, availability below 99.50% is classified as a **P1 Severe Breach** (< 99.50% Monthly Availability), which incurs a **25%** service credit on the monthly CLIN fee (*05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf*, p. 1).
* **Credit Calculation:** 
  $$\$45,000.00 \times 0.25 = \mathbf{\$11,250.00}$$
  *(This exact scenario is confirmed in the Clause SLA-4.2 example in 05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf, p. 1).*

---

### 2. CLIN-0002-AA: GKE Enterprise Managed Cluster
* **Base Rate & Monthly Billing:** 
  * Billed at **$1,250.00/month per node** (*04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf*, p. 1).
  * For 20 active nodes in Month 4, the monthly invoice fee is:
    $$20 \text{ nodes} \times \$1,250.00/\text{node} = \mathbf{\$25,000.00}$$
* **Monthly Availability:** **99.70%**.
* **SLA Classification & Credit Percentage:**
  * Under Clause SLA-4.2, availability between < 99.99% and 99.50% falls under **P1 Critical** (99.99% Target), incurring a **10%** service credit of the monthly CLIN fee (*05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf*, p. 1).*
* **Credit Calculation:**
  $$\$25,000.00 \times 0.10 = \mathbf{\$2,500.00}$$

*(Note: If GKE were categorized as a "Non-Core Service" under Tier P2 High for availability < 99.90%, the credit percentage would be 5% ($1,250.00) under 05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf, p. 1; however, GKE hosts "Core ERP & 45 Microservices" per 02_Statement_of_Work_SOW.pdf, p. 1).*

---

### 3. Combined Total Service Credit
* **CLIN-0001-AA Credit:** $11,250.00
* **CLIN-0002-AA Credit (P1 Critical):** $2,500.00
* **Combined Total Credit Owed:** 
  $$\$11,250.00 + \$2,500.00 = \mathbf{\$13,750.00}$$

*(If GKE were evaluated under P2 High at 5% / $1,250.00, the combined credit would be **$12,500.00**).*

The answer reaches the reference total of $13,750.00 with correct tier classification, though the extra P2 alternative of $12,500 adds slight hedging. Only the SLA matrix and pricing schedule chunks are needed; most other chunks are off-topic, including other solicitations, DR amendments, architecture, and vendor proposals.

* **Monthly Availability:** **99.40%**.
* **SLA Classification & Credit Percentage:** 
  * Under Clause SLA-4.2, availability below 99.50% is classified as a **P1 Severe Breach** (< 99.50% Monthly Availability), which incurs a **25%** service credit on the monthly CLIN fee (*05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf*, p. 1).
* **Credit Calculation:** 
  $$\$45,000.00 \times 0.25 = \mathbf{\$11,250.00}$$
  *(This exact scenario is confirmed in the Clause SLA-4.2 example in 05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf, p. 1).*

---

### 2. CLIN-0002-AA: GKE Enterprise Managed Cluster
* **Base Rate & Monthly Billing:** 
  * Billed at **$1,250.00/month per node** (*04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf*, p. 1).
  * For 20 active nodes in Month 4, the monthly invoice fee is:
    $$20 \text{ nodes} \times \$1,250.00/\text{node} = \mathbf{\$25,000.00}$$
* **Monthly Availability:** **99.70%**.
* **SLA Classification & Credit Percentage:**
  * Under Clause SLA-4.2, availability between < 99.99% and 99.50% falls under **P1 Critical** (99.99% Target), incurring a **10%** service credit of the monthly CLIN fee (*05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf*, p. 1).*
* **Credit Calculation:**
  $$\$25,000.00 \times 0.10 = \mathbf{\$2,500.00}$$

*(Note: If GKE were categorized as a "Non-Core Service" under Tier P2 High for availability < 99.90%, the credit percentage would be 5% ($1,250.00) under 05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf, p. 1; however, GKE hosts "Core ERP & 45 Microservices" per 02_Statement_of_Work_SOW.pdf, p. 1).*

---

### 3. Combined Total Service Credit
* **CLIN-0001-AA Credit:** $11,250.00
* **CLIN-0002-AA Credit (P1 Critical):** $2,500.00
* **Combined Total Credit Owed:** 
  $$\$11,250.00 + \$2,500.00 = \mathbf{\$13,750.00}$$

*(If GKE were evaluated under P2 High at 5% / $1,250.00, the combined credit would be **$12,500.00**).*

Based on the retrieved procurement records for Solicitation **SOL-2026-CLOUD-01**, here is the calculation of the SLA service credits owed under Exhibit 05:

---

### 1. CLIN-0001-AA: Shared VPC & Landing Zone Core
* **Monthly Fee:** **$45,000.00/month** (*04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf*, p. 1; *05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf*, p. 1).
* **Monthly Availability:** **99.40%**.
* **SLA Classification & Credit Percentage:** 
  * Under Clause SLA-4.2, availability below 99.50% is classified as a **P1 Severe Breach** (< 99.50% Monthly Availability), which incurs a **25%** service credit on the monthly CLIN fee (*05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf*, p. 1).
* **Credit Calculation:** 
  $$\$45,000.00 \times 0.25 = \mathbf{\$11,250.00}$$
  *(This exact scenario is confirmed in the Clause SLA-4.2 example in 05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf, p. 1).*

---

### 2. CLIN-0002-AA: GKE Enterprise Managed Cluster
* **Base Rate & Monthly Billing:** 
  * Billed at **$1,250.00/month per node** (*04_Pricing_Schedule_CLINs.pdf*, p. 1).
  * For 20 active nodes in Month 4, the monthly invoice fee is:
    $$20 \text{ nodes} \times \$1,250.00/\text{node} = \mathbf{\$25,000.00}$$
* **Monthly Availability:** **99.70%**.
* **SLA Classification & Credit Percentage:**
  * Under Clause SLA-4.2, availability between < 99.99% and 99.50% falls under **P1 Critical** (99.99% Target), incurring a **10%** service credit of the monthly CLIN fee (*05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf*, p. 1).*
* **Credit Calculation:**
  $$\$25,000.00 \times 0.10 = \mathbf{\$2,500.00}$$

*(Note: If GKE were categorized as a "Non-Core Service" under Tier P2 High for availability < 99.90%, the credit percentage would be 5% ($1,250.00) under 05_SLA_and_QASP_Requirements.pdf, p. 1; however, GKE hosts "Core ERP & 45 Microservices" per 02_Statement_of_Work_SOW.pdf, p. 1).*

---

### 3. Combined Total Service Credit
* **CLIN-0001-AA Credit:** $11,250.00
* **CLIN-0002-AA Credit (P1 Critical):** $2,500.00
* **Combined Total Credit Owed:** 
  $$\$11,250.00 + \$2,500.00 = \mathbf{\$13,750.00}$$

*(If GKE were evaluated under P2 High at 5% / $1,250.00, the combined credit would be **$12,500.00**).*
